rationale: Correct-color approach occurred in the development flights, but stopping and continued safe stand-off were insufficient.
Train01 independent new navigation velocities were limited to about +/-0.14 and +/-0.12 m/s, while development estimates reached over 0.20 m/s.
Original-scene navigation was sampled much less often than new far-field counterfactuals; increase near-goal and original-scene retention.
These are development diagnoses; this attempt does not isolate a single causal factor.

training.recovery_selection: latest saved recovery by step only, never validation score
training.sampling: Alternate a counterfactual quartet and four near-goal navigation samples in microbatch 0; microbatch 1 has two navigation samples (80% near-goal) and two retained primitives. Every independent navigation sample chooses new/retained domain with equal probability, balanced blue/red. Approximately 45% near-goal, 25% counterfactual, 5% other navigation, 25% primitives.
training.loss: Original flow matching; shared noise across paired counterfactuals; no oracle features in model batch
training.data: Reuse unchanged 6408 JPEGs. Keep original examples; add zero-velocity and two disk-uniform velocity state variants to airborne visible navigation, recomputing the same frozen teacher. No development or held-out images used for gradients.

augmentation.counterpart_rule: Both shirt assignments share the same state variants; both instructions are generated for each visible target. No color can be inferred uniquely from the state variant.

frozen: Runtime code, controller gains, detector, success criteria, all original development and held-out layouts/seeds, static-probe conditions and thresholds
evaluation: Final step only. Run the same eight development cases, then five original rescue regressions only if 8/8; held-out comparison only if all pass. Retain all previous and new failures.
weights_selection: Continue from completed train01 final; no intermediate step selected by score
